task: You need to notify two different audiences about the same product outage: (1) internal engineering Slack channel, (2) the public status-page update shown to customers. Draft both. The engineering message can include technical detail (which service, error rate). The customer-facing one must not speculate about root cause before it's confirmed and must not use internal jargon.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) the engineering message includes real technical specifics (service name, error rate/metric) that the customer-facing one omits; (b) the customer-facing message does NOT speculate about root cause (e.g. does not say 'caused by a database migration' unless that's actually confirmed in the prompt, which it isn't); (c) the customer-facing message avoids internal jargon/service names a customer wouldn't recognize; (d) both messages are honest about impact -- neither downplays nor overstates the outage relative to what's known.
